title: Consolidate weight format negotiation and async tokenizer boundary API
creator: Samir Gupta
description: Clean up the model loading pipeline by consolidating weight format negotiation into a single manifest layer, adding a backward-compatible manifest v2 shim, and introducing an async tokenizer boundary API to decouple I/O from tokenization. Goals: reduce cold-start latency, simplify supported checkpoint formats, and make tokenizer integration non-blocking for streaming loads.
comments: 2025-01-16: Kickoff meeting — agreed scope: manifest normalization, format alias table, tokenizer contract API, and one end-to-end integration test. Stakeholders: runtime, model-onboarding, and infra.
2025-01-20: Spike results — prototype manifest v2 (compact index + alias table) reduces manifest parse time by ~35% for large model bundles. Disk seek counts reduced on sample 12GB checkpoint.
2025-01-23: Design doc uploaded to Confluence. Decision: keep backward-compatible manifest v1 parser and provide v2->v1 shim in loader to avoid forcing immediate consumer changes.
2025-01-27: Dependency audit — bumped protobuf from 3.20.x to 3.22.x to support schema evolution for manifest v2. Verified ABI compatibility in CI images.

2025-01-29: Implemented async tokenizer boundary (TokenReader.async_next_chunk()). This allows model loader to stream raw byte chunks while tokenizer runs concurrently. Initial microbench: 18% reduction in cold-start latency for long contexts.
2025-01-30: PR 5678 opened — loader: manifest v2 parser + alias table + streaming shard reader. Requesting review from Diego Morales and Priya Singh.
2025-01-31: Design review feedback — prefer explicit format_alias registry instead of heuristics; also add a safety check to reject unknown weight compression codecs. Added to checklist.

2025-02-01: Benchmarks on p3.2xlarge equivalent: full model warmup path (including tokenizer load) improved from 1.8s to 1.45s median. Memory overhead for mmap pooling measured at +12MB per worker — acceptable.
2025-02-02: Security review: no sensitive material changes; KMS flows unaffected. Confirmed by Security (Marta Lopez) — security_review_required=false for this ticket.
2025-02-03: Blocker noted — packaging for on-prem artifacts needs update due to protobuf bump; infra will provide new wheels. Added dependency ENG-16789 as blocker for packaging.

Next steps: address packaging blocker, land PRs in two phases (manifest+shard reader, tokenizer boundary), add E2E test in CI for streaming cold-start scenario. Rollout plan: runtime-1.20 can enable manifest_v2 behind feature flag.

Rollout mitigation: If manifest_v2 causes regression, runtime will fall back to manifest_v1 via compatibility flag; added monitoring query to alert on >10% regressions in cold-start latency within 24h of rollout.
